brief:
Palestinian citizens of Israel face intensified scrutiny following Arab parties' gains in recent elections, according to Al Jazeera English. Community members report increased pressure and what they describe as "loyalty tests" tied to the electoral success, though specific details of these pressures remain unclear from available reporting.

The situation reflects broader tensions between Palestinian Arab political representation and Israel's majority Jewish establishment. Arab parties have historically faced suspicion from Israeli authorities and society regarding their political allegiances and independence.
dek: Palestinian citizens of Israel say Arab parties' success in recent elections has led to growing pressure.
title: Israel pressures Palestinian citizens over Arab party election wins
